articles.title: Understanding Homeopathic Potencies: 6C, 30C, 200C and LM Scale Explained
articles.titleHi: होम्योपैथिक पोटेंसी को समझें: 6C, 30C, 200C और LM स्केल क्या हैं?
articles.author: Dr. Anjali Sharma, M.D. (Hom.)
articles.summary: Why a higher number like 200C does not simply mean "stronger" like allopathic milligrams, and when doctors select LM potencies for sensitive patients.
articles.content:
Patients often ask whether 200C is simply a higher dose than 30C. In homeopathy, potency refers to the degree of serial dilution and succussion rather than chemical weight.

Low potencies (3X, 6X, 6C) act gently at the tissue and organ level and are frequently chosen for acute physical complaints or Schüssler tissue salts. Medium potencies (30C) bridge acute and sub-acute constitutional work. High potencies (200C, 1M) are reserved for clear constitutional totality under clinical supervision.

Hahnemann’s 50-millesimal (LM) scale—introduced in the 6th edition of the Organon—uses a 1:50,000 dilution ratio that allows daily, finely calibrated repetition in sensitive skin, respiratory, or neurological cases without sharp aggravations.

articles.title: Five Practical Rules for Storing & Taking Homeopathic Medicines in Indian Summers
articles.titleHi: गर्मियों में होम्योपैथिक दवाइयों को सुरक्षित रखने और लेने के 5 जरूरी नियम
articles.author: Dr. Anjali Sharma, M.D. (Hom.)
articles.summary: How heat, camphor, strong mint, and handling globules with bare fingers affect remedy purity—and simple habits to preserve potency.
articles.content:
Homeopathic remedies are prepared on sensitive sucrose globules or purified hydro-alcoholic diluents. To preserve their integrity:

1. Store bottles in a cool, dark cabinet below 30°C away from direct sunlight and kitchen heat.
2. Keep remedies separate from camphor, eucalyptus balm, naphthalene balls, and strong essential oils.
3. Pour globules directly into the bottle cap rather than touching them with fingers.
4. Maintain a 20–30 minute clean-mouth gap before and after taking a dose—avoiding coffee, raw onion, or mint toothpaste right around dosing.
5. Never mix multiple unlabeled bottles together; always verify the medicine name, potency, and expiry date.

articles.title: Seasonal Allergic Rhinitis in Delhi NCR: A Constitutional Homeopathic Approach
articles.titleHi: मौसमी एलर्जी और साइनस: होम्योपैथिक दृष्टिकोण
articles.author: Dr. Anjali Sharma, M.D. (Hom.)
articles.summary: Why morning sneezing and dust sensitivity flare up during weather transitions and how individualized case-taking reduces dependency on daily antihistamines.
articles.content:
Every October and February, weather shifts and particulate dust trigger intense morning sneezing, watery eyes, and sinus congestion across North India.

Instead of applying one standard nasal spray for everyone, a classical homeopath differentiates whether your nasal discharge burns the upper lip (Allium cepa / Arsenicum), whether the eyes water irritably while the nose stays bland (Euphrasia), or whether thick post-nasal congestion builds pressure over the eyebrows (Kali bichromicum).

Addressing the underlying susceptibility during symptom-free months helps reduce the intensity and frequency of seasonal flares.

faqs.answerHi: ऑनलाइन स्लॉट बुक करने के बाद क्लिनिक टीम व्हाट्सएप पर समय की पुष्टि करती है। वीडियो परामर्श के बाद सीलबंद दवाइयां पूरे भारत में कूरियर द्वारा भेजी जाती हैं।

faqs.question: Why are some newly imported medicines marked Pending Review?
faqs.questionHi: निर्देशिका में कुछ नई दवाइयां केवल समीक्षा के बाद ही क्यों प्रकाशित होती हैं?
faqs.answer: To uphold patient safety and pharmacopoeia accuracy, every newly added or CSV/Excel-imported remedy remains unpublished until an authorized administrator verifies its botanical source, classical reference, and safety notice.
faqs.answerHi: रोगी सुरक्षा और सटीकता के लिए, CSV/Excel से आयातित कोई भी नया रिकॉर्ड अधिकृत एडमिनिस्ट्रेटर द्वारा सत्यापित होने तक प्रकाशित नहीं किया जाता।
